positive_findings: The singular controlled-study title matches the bounded evidence.
The abstract is synchronized with the corrected Granite interval upper endpoint 0.3689 and explicitly discloses the synthetic, exposed evidence boundary.
DKASQL is recognized as a direct same-journal predecessor, with no first-in-domain, reproduction, or numerical-superiority claim.
The three framework figures are readable and accurately remove ranking, repair, and repeated-generation implications.
The Results preserve complete 1440-prediction accounting, corrected common-target diagnostics, and cluster-aware inference.
The Discussion preserves negative results and does not promote the external 15 matches as accuracy.

issues.title: Applied power-grid validity remains below the journal threshold
issues.finding: All canonical quantitative evidence comes from 180 development-visible questions over one synthetic 8-table, 98-row database; RTS-GMLC and SimBench pairs remain automatic, visible, and unreviewed.
issues.required_action: Complete dual independent review and adjudication of the 91 visible candidates, then execute a genuinely new family-isolated sealed grid-domain confirmatory set after method freeze, reporting visible and sealed results separately.

issues.title: No executed public or literature-level comparator
issues.finding: The DKASQL table is appropriately qualitative, but the canonical study contains only internal factorial cells. The prospective BIRD comparison remains blocked at 499/500 and has zero model calls.
issues.required_action: Resolve and independently sign the BIRD Q701 evaluator boundary, freeze, and run the registered four-method/two-backbone comparison. If not completed, move detailed BIRD blocker material out of the main Methods and add defensible same-data comparator baselines without claiming DKASQL reproduction.

issues.title: Semantic reliability is not validated beyond one database state
issues.finding: Single-state execution equality may accept nonequivalent SQL; no blinded semantic audit or discriminating perturbed/test-suite database evaluation has been completed.
issues.required_action: Add a prospectively sampled blinded semantic audit or frozen test-suite/perturbed-state evaluation and report false agreement; replace 'strict execution correctness' with 'strict execution equality on the frozen database state.'

issues.title: Public reproducibility and mandatory submission metadata remain unresolved
issues.finding: GridDB redistribution permission, permanent public DOI/URL, authorship, CRediT, funding, conflicts, acknowledgments, ethics confirmations, and final AI-use disclosure remain open.
issues.required_action: Obtain permission or a licensed deterministic regeneration route, review all source-specific licenses, deposit permitted artifacts at a permanent DOI, and replace every W10_FRONT_MATTER placeholder with author-approved metadata.

issues.title: Abstract should quantify the primary database and soften validation wording
issues.required_action: Retain the title; state 8 tables/98 rows in the abstract and replace 'backbone-specific validation' with 'two-snapshot sensitivity evidence' or equivalent.

issues.title: Completed methods and unexecuted prospective work should be separated
issues.required_action: Move the DKASQL boundary to Related Work and detailed BIRD/Q701 protocol material to a supplement or concise Future Work note unless the baseline is executed.

issues.title: BIRD extraction status is inconsistent across support documents
issues.required_action: Update the license checklist to reflect safe extraction and bind download, extraction, preflight, and zero-model-call states to one authoritative manifest.

issues.title: Result figures can communicate uncertainty and selector failures more directly
issues.required_action: Add uncertainty marks or a point-estimate label to Figure 4; annotate Figure 6 with 155/180 complete-column and 115/116 join-path coverage, or provide a small companion panel.

issues.title: Conference bibliography entries duplicate 'Proceedings of the'
issues.required_action: Normalize BibTeX booktitle fields so the MDPI style introduces each proceedings title once; recheck page ranges and capitalization.

issues.title: Present claim discipline must be preserved
issues.required_action: Do not promote token reduction to efficiency, offline gold coverage to online selection quality, 15 external matches to accuracy, or the three-way modifier to a general backbone ranking.

reviewer_independence_note: This Round-2 decision was formed from the latest manuscript/PDF and evidence artifacts; Round-1 responses were checked for closure but were not adopted as the Round-2 decision.
